title: Thirumathi Palanisamy
desc: Hamsaveni, a teacher, agrees to wed an uneducated man on the condition that she will stay with her sick father post marriage. However, the man refuses to comply with her terms on the wedding night.

title: Aararo Aariraro
desc: A woman is admitted to a psychiatric institution, where she grows close to Babu, a caretaker. However, he is later compelled to marry her after she reveals her pregnancy.

title: Solaikuyil
desc: Maruthu arrives in Mulimalai, claiming kinship to a respected figure, but the village guard, Maayandi, is suspicious. Soon, a murder investigation raises questions about Maruthu's identity.

title: Anthimanthaarai
desc: A fugitive freedom fighter finds sanctuary in the home of a compassionate woman. As they form an unexpected bond, their growing friendship transforms both their lives in unforeseen ways.

title: Sachin
